prompt: This repo ships a Claude Code plugin under harness-adapters/. For the z0intelligence plugin (not the ObservationPack one), work out: which Claude Code hook events it registers and which `z0int.claude_code` subcommand each runs; which environment variable turns the SessionStart state packet on and which one sets its token budget, and the default budget; and which environment variable (with what value) makes the UserPromptSubmit hook deliver context instead of running in shadow mode. Write ANSWERS.json with keys: "hooks": object mapping event name to subcommand; "packet_env": string; "packet_tokens_env": string; "packet_tokens_default": number; "shadow_off": string of the form NAME=VALUE.
